units.text: And it shall be, when all these things come upon you, the blessing and the curse which I have set before your face, and you receive them into your heart among all the nations whither the Lord has scattered you,
and you return unto the Lord your God, and obey His voice according to all that I command you this day, with all your heart and with all your soul,
then the Lord shall heal your sins, and have mercy upon you, and shall gather you again from all the nations whither the Lord has scattered you.
If your dispersion is from one end of heaven unto the other end of heaven, from thence shall the Lord your God gather you, and from thence shall the Lord your God take you.
And the Lord your God shall bring you into the land which your fathers inherited, and you shall inherit it; and He shall do you good, and make you more numerous than your fathers.
Leave Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Announce a voice of rejoicing, and let this be heard; proclaim it to the earth’s extremity. Say, “The Lord rescued His slave Jacob.”
Even if they thirst, He will lead them through a wilderness and bring water out of a rock for them. A rock will split and water will flow, and My people will drink.
“There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,” says the Lord.
And His people Jacob became the portion of the Lord; Israel, the measured lot of His inheritance.
He sustained him in a wilderness land, in the thirst of burning heat, in a waterless place; He compassed him about, and instructed him, and kept him as the pupil of an eye.
As an eagle would shelter its nest, it yearned over its young; spreading its wings, it received them, and took them up upon its back.
The Lord alone led them, and there was no foreign god with them.
I cried out, for Thou heardest me, God; incline Thine ear to me and hear my words.
Make Thy mercies wonderful, Thou who savest those hoping in Thee from those who oppose Thy right hand.
Guard me as the pupil of an eye; in the shelter of Thy wings Thou wilt shelter me,
from the ungodly who made me miserable. My enemies surrounded my soul.
The Lord will pity Jacob and again choose Israel; they will rest upon their land, and the resident foreigner will be added to them and added to Jacob’s house,

and nations will take them and bring them into their place; they will inherit and multiply upon God’s land as male and female slaves. Those who took them captive will be captives, and those who ruled them will be ruled.
On that day God will give you rest from pain, your wrath and the harsh slavery in which you served them,
Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion! Proclaim, daughter Jerusalem! Be glad and delight with all your heart, daughter Jerusalem!
The Lord removed your wrongdoings and has redeemed you from your enemies’ hand. The Lord, King of Israel, is within you; you will see evils no more.
At that time the Lord will say to Jerusalem, “Take courage, Zion; do not let your hands hang loose.
The Lord your God is within you; mighty, He shall save you. He shall bring gladness upon you, and renew you in His love; and He shall rejoice over you with delight, as on a day of feasting.”
I will gather the crushed. Alas! Who took up reproach against her?
Look, I am acting within you for your sake at that time, says the Lord. I will save the oppressed and the rejected; I will receive them and make them a boast and renowned throughout the earth.

They will be ashamed at that time, when I do good to you and when I receive you. I will make you renowned and a boast among all the earth’s peoples, when I turn your captivity before you, says the Lord.
Let no foreigner attached to the Lord say, “Will the Lord then separate me from His people?” And let no eunuch say, “I am a dry tree.”
Thus says the Lord: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, choose what I wish, and hold fast to My covenant,
I will give them in My house and wall a renowned place better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, and it will not fail.

And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—

I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
What use is a carved image, that they carved it? They formed it as a cast object, a false appearance, because its maker trusted his creation, making mute idols.
Woe to the one saying to wood, ‘Wake and rise!’ and to stone, ‘Be lifted up!’ It is an appearance, a plate of gold and silver, and no breath at all is in it.
But the Lord is in His holy sanctuary; let all the earth revere Him.”
When that day came, behold, the angels of God came to stand before the Lord, and the devil came with them.
The Lord said to the devil, “Where have you come from?” The devil answered the Lord, “I have come after going around the earth and walking through the world beneath heaven.”
The Lord said to him, “Have you paid attention in your mind to My servant Job? For among those on earth there is no man like him—blameless, true, God-fearing, keeping away from every evil deed.”
The devil answered before the Lord, “Does Job worship God for nothing?

Hast Thou not fenced in what is outside him and what is inside his house, and everything around all that belongs to him? Thou hast blessed the works of his hands and made his livestock numerous in the land.
But stretch out Thy hand and touch everything he has; surely he will curse Thee to Thy face.”
Then the Lord said to the devil, “Behold, everything he has I give into your hand, but do not touch him.” And the devil went out from the Lord.
Appoint a sinner over him, and let a slanderer stand at his right hand.
When he is judged, may he come out condemned, and let his prayer become sin.
Yet in the same way these people too, in their dreaming, defile flesh, reject dominion, and slander glorious ones.
But Michael the archangel, when he was contending with the devil and disputing about the body of Moses, did not dare to bring a slanderous judgment against him, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you.”
But these people slander whatever they do not know; and what they understand by instinct, like unreasoning animals, becomes the very thing by which they are corrupted.
“I overthrew you as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you became like a firebrand snatched from fire. Yet not even so did you turn to Me,” says the Lord.

and they will rejoice greatly in the Lord.” Let my soul exult in the Lord, for He clothed me in a garment of salvation and a tunic of joy. Like a bridegroom He placed a turban on me, and like a bride He adorned me with ornaments.
As earth increases its flower and a garden its seeds, so the Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.
We all became like unclean people; all our righteousness is like a menstruating woman’s rag. We fell away like leaves because of our lawless deeds; thus wind will carry us off.
There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.
But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.
“And bring to yourself Aaron your brother and his sons from among the sons of Israel, to serve Me as priests: Aaron, and Nadab, and Abihu, and Eleazar, and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron.
You shall make a holy robe for Aaron your brother, for honour and glory.
Speak to everyone skilled in understanding whom I have filled with a spirit of perception. They shall make Aaron’s holy robe for the sanctuary, in which he shall serve Me as priest.

These are the robes they shall make: a breastpiece, a shoulder-piece, a full-length robe, a tasselled tunic, a turban, and a sash. They shall make holy robes for Aaron and his sons to serve Me as priests.
They shall take gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
Take the tribe of Levi, and you shall set them before Aaron the priest, and they shall minister unto him;
And they shall keep his charges and the charges of the sons of Israel before the Tent of Testimony, performing the work of the Tent.
And they shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Testimony and the charges of the sons of Israel, according to all the work of the Tent.
And you shall give the Levites unto Aaron and unto his sons, the priests. These are given unto Me as a gift from the sons of Israel.

And you shall appoint Aaron and his sons over the Tent of Testimony, and they shall keep their priesthood, and all that concerns the altar and is within the veil. And the outsider who touches shall die.
Behold, days are coming, says the Lord, and I will raise up a righteous rising for David. A king will reign and understand, doing judgment and righteousness upon the earth.
In his days Judah will be saved and Israel will dwell confidently. This is his name, which the Lord will call him: Josedek.
In the last days the mountain of the Lord will be manifest, established upon the mountain summits and raised above the hills, and peoples will hurry toward it.

Many nations will go and say, “Come, let us go up to the Lord’s mountain and to the house of Jacob’s God. They will show us His way, and we will walk in His paths.” For law will go out from Zion, and the Lord’s word from Jerusalem.

He will judge between many peoples and reprove strong nations as far as a distant land. They will cut their swords into plows and their spears into sickles. Nation will certainly no longer raise sword against nation, nor will they learn to wage war anymore.
Each will rest beneath his vine and each beneath his fig tree, and there will be no one causing fear, because the mouth of the Lord Almighty has spoken these things.
